title: Avoca Alternatives for Service Businesses
description: Compare Avoca alternatives for service businesses. Off The Clock AI, Sameday, ServiceTitan and Jobber: quoting, human backup, coaching and costs.
intro: Call coaching can improve a conversation. QuoteDone changes who has to finish the quote after it.
verdict: Choose Off The Clock when you want your operator to carry the inquiry through the job price and booking. QuoteDone adds your rates and website quoting—not another pricing callback for you.
reason: Avoca’s offer includes inbound AI, outbound campaigns, web chat and Coach. It also documents a Human in the Loop program staffed by Avoca-trained CSRs in North America. Those are real distinctions and should not be reduced to a generic “AI receptionist” label. [[avoca-product]] [[avoca-human]]

A scored call, a human handoff and a calculated job quote solve different problems. Coaching helps a team assess conversations. External human coverage provides another person. QuoteDone applies the owner’s pricing to the supported job the customer described.

Off The Clock includes the operator functions around that price: answering business questions, scheduling, transfers and follow-up. QuoteDone is the addition that removes routine quote preparation from the owner—not a smaller substitute for the operator.
choices: For a painting inquiry, walls, ceiling and trim are distinct scope. QuoteDone accounts for the selected supported items using your rates; uncertainty stays visible for review. The website widget gives the same kind of inquiry a second entry point.

Sameday’s product range overlaps Avoca in campaigns and coaching while also presenting a phone-system offer. Its published packages supply starting prices and minute allowances; the comparison is broader than voice quality alone. [[sameday-product]] [[sameday-pricing]]

ServiceTitan’s agent uses its account’s job types, fees and booking context. This is a native software capability rather than an outsourced human program. It is relevant to the platform decision, not evidence that the project quote is already automated. [[st-settings]]

Jobber offers answering within its existing business software. Its conversation-based add-on is a different purchase from Avoca’s front-office modules. It remains a Jobber account feature, not a complete replacement for the surrounding Avoca product range. [[jobber-help]]
decision: Choose Off The Clock to take routine job pricing off your plate while keeping exceptions in your hands. The result to buy is a customer who has an answer and a next step—not another call record awaiting your quote.
faqs: Yes. Avoca describes its own trained-CSR program. Confirm its inclusion and coverage in the plan you are considering. [[avoca-human]]
Does Off The Clock include an outsourced receptionist team?
No. Human transfers are to your business team. QuoteDone’s value is applying your own pricing to supported inquiries and retaining complete details when your judgment is needed.
card_description: Separate Avoca’s call coaching and trained-human program from the task QuoteDone takes on: pricing the customer’s complete supported job.
sections: Avoca’s trained-human program is distinct from a transfer to your own team. The program’s inclusion and coverage depend on the offer; its existence does not mean every subscription includes unlimited external staffing. [[avoca-human]]

Off The Clock transfers callers when a person is needed and keeps pricing decisions with you. A missing measurement or an unpriced item becomes a complete review request. An owner’s judgment is preserved without making the owner responsible for every routine price question.
Know the subscription before the sales conversation
The reviewed Avoca product material does not establish a numerical subscription price. Its total cost is therefore proposal-specific. [[avoca-product]]

QuoteDone is $279 per month with 1,200 minutes, the operator and website quote widget. Overage is $0.35 per minute and there is no setup fee. That is a defined product offer—not a promise to replace an external human team or every coaching module.
